title: Gears timing pulley description, version 1
description: Static structure and scalar limits for the first GT 2 mm pulley contract. Cross-field geometry rules are defined in docs/contract.md.

schemaVersion.description: Major version of the persisted input format.

kind.description: Part family handled by this contract.

units.description: Unit for every dimensional input and output unless explicitly stated otherwise.

profile.description: Experimental polyline derived from the legacy prototype; pitch and outside diameter are verified, exact groove shape is not.

toothCount.description: Number of equally spaced pulley grooves.

toothedWidth.description: Axial width of the toothed rim, centered on z=0 from -toothedWidth/2 to +toothedWidth/2.

radialThickness.description: Radial material thickness inward from the tooth-root radius to the inner rim radius.

axialThickness.description: Axial flange thickness measured away from the toothed rim.

radialExtension.description: Radial projection beyond the pulley outside radius.

lower.description: Flange below z=-toothedWidth/2; null means absent.

upper.description: Flange above z=+toothedWidth/2; null means absent.

axialThickness.description: Axial thickness of the web or spokes.

axialOffset.description: Z coordinate of the web mid-plane relative to the toothed-rim mid-plane at z=0; positive is toward the upper side.

type.description: A continuous annular web between hub and rim.
Equally spaced straight radial spokes with mandatory in-plane fillets.

count.description: Number of equally spaced straight radial spokes.

width.description: Tangential width of each straight spoke before root fillets.

filletRadius.description: In-plane radius of both hub-to-spoke and spoke-to-rim fillets.

boreDiameter.description: Diameter of the centered cylindrical through bore.

outerDiameter.description: Outside diameter of the cylindrical hub.

lowerExtension.description: Hub projection below the lower toothed-rim face at z=-toothedWidth/2.

upperExtension.description: Hub projection above the upper toothed-rim face at z=+toothedWidth/2.

maxChordError.description: Maximum radial sagitta in millimetres for generated circular arcs; it is a meshing setting, not a physical dimension.
